Are you tired of boring father-daughter photos? Japanese photographer Yûki Aoyama has a funny way to make them more interesting. In her new photos, the daughters look straight at the camera and smile. Their fathers jump high in the air next to them. These pictures are from Aoyama's new book, which is called "Daughter and Salary Man."

Police are looking for a man, who is between 50 and 60 years old, for robbing a bank. He took £3,000 in cash and ran away. The robbery happened at 12:30 pm at a Lloyds Bank in Fairwater, Cardiff. The police showed pictures from security cameras of the suspect. He is between 5 feet 9 inches and 6 feet tall. He was wearing black clothes. The man is white, has black hair with some grey, and wore glasses. The cameras caught him inside the bank. The police said no one was hurt. They are sure the public can help them find him.

The Court of Arbitration for Sport has ended Morocco's ban from the next two African Cup of Nations. The ban was originally imposed by the Confederation of African Football (CAF). Morocco was kicked out of the 2017 and 209 tournaments and was fined $1 million. CAF also asked for an extra $9 million in compensation because Morocco withdrew as host due to fears about the Ebola epidemic. The African Cup of Nations was won by Ivory Coast in Equatorial Guinea. Morocco can now compete in the next two African Cup of Nations.

Tom Boyd thinks that Jason Denayer’s time on loan at Celtic has been so successful that he is now ready to compete for a spot at Manchester City next season. This would mean Ronny Deila’s plan to keep the young Belgian player for another year would fail, but Boyd sees a good side to it. Boyd, the former Celtic captain, believes Denayer’s success can serve as a great example to encourage other young players to take the next step in their careers at Parkhead. The 19-year defender, Jason Denayer (left), has done well on loan at Celtic this season. The 19-year player recently earned his first international cap for Belgium in a Euro 216 qualifier against Cyprus

Andros Townsend scored a amazing goal for England in Italy, and he said that critics like Paul Merson were exactly the motivation he needed. This has been a difficult season for the 23-year-old, who hasn’t played as well as he did when he first started playing for the national team. England’s coach, Roy Hodgson, still believed in him, and Townsend proved that faith by scoring a great goal at the Juventus Stadium. Andros Townsend scored England’s equal goal in their 1-1 friendly match against Italy in Turin on Tuesday night. Townsend celebrated his goal with his Tottenham teammates, Ryan Mason (left) and Kyle Walker.

Chinese company Dalian Wanda Group has officially bought 20% of Spanish football team Atletico Madrid. This was confirmed at a special meeting on Tuesday. Wanda’s legal team signed papers to buy 726,707 shares for €45 million (£32.8 million). The deal was first announced in January. Two special meetings were needed to approve it. Wanda’s chairman, Wang Jianlin, wants to make Atletico Madrid more famous in Asia. Atletico Madrid’s manager, Diego Simeone, spoke to the news reporters.

Antonio Conte said that his return to Turin for Italy’s 1-1 draw against England was a happy memory. despite reports that he received death threats in the days before the friendly match. Conte became Italy’s manager in August, replacing Cesare Prandelli, after Italy was eliminated in the group stage of last summer’s World Cup. However, his first seven months as head coach have been difficult. Italy needed a late goal from Eder to tie 2-2 with Bulgaria last Saturday. Conte reportedly received death threats from Juventus fans after midfielder Claudio Marchisio injured his knee the day before the Euro 216 qualifier.

Ian Murray thinks that the final month of the Scottish Championship season could be easier for Hibernian (Hibs) than for Rangers. His team, Dumbarton, has already played both of his former clubs this season and will face them again in the coming weeks.

Even though Rangers are currently doing well— beating Hibs and Cowdenbeath— and Hibs have lost to Raith, Murray believes the advantage will soon shift back to Hibs. He thinks Rangers will find it hard to keep up their current form until the end of the season.

Simon Mignolet, the goalkeeper for Liverpool, posted photos of himself sitting in an airplane cockpit with pilots on his Facebook page. He was returning to England after playing for the Belgian national team in Euro 2016 qualifying matches against Cyprus and Israel. Although Mignolet was on the team list for both games, he did not play because the coach chose another goalkeeper, Thibaut Courtois. Mignolet has 14 international caps.

Chyknell Hall Estate, a large country property near Bridgnorth in Shropshire, is for sale. The price is £6 million. The estate covers 200 acres of land. It includes a Grade II-listed manor house and five cottages. The property also has a swimming pool, a tennis court, stables, and its own cricket pitch. The main house, Chyknell Hall, was built in 1814. It has 11 bedrooms. It has only been sold twice since it was built. The large, private grounds offer complete privacy, which could attract famous buyers.

Two college police officers in Dallas are on administrative leave after a video showed them harassing four students and arresting one. The video shows the officers hitting the student before arresting him. The incident happened at El Centro College last Wednesday. Student Charles Adams recorded the video on his phone. Adams was smoking a cigarette when he saw what happened. The officers approached the students while they were waiting for a bus outside the downtown Dallas campus.

Kilmarnock has made Gary Locke the permanent manager. He signed a three-year contract. Locke, 39, was the assistant manager at the club last summer. He worked under Allan Johnston. When Johnston left in early February, Locke took charge of the team. Locke used to play for Hearts, and Johnston was his former teammate. Locke has won almost all his games since he started. In seven games, he has only lost once. He will speak to the press on Friday morning. Locke shook hands with chairman Jim Mann after signing the new deal.

This weekend, one of the biggest events in German football happens. The usual excitement for this match, recently called "Der Klassiker," has been lessened. Borussia Dortmund and Bayern Munich have won the last five Bundesliga titles, and Bayern is expected to keep winning this season. However, these two teams are now far apart in the standings: Bayern has 31 more points and is nine places higher than Dortmund. This does not mean the game is less important than usual when these two teams play each other. Jurgen Klopp, the coach of Borussia Dortmund, is shown celebrating with his players after they beat Hannover.

14-year schoolgirl Deva Joseph was stuck at London Stansted airport when easyJet refused to let her on her flight to Spain. Because she had two carry-on bags, the airline said she couldn't board. Deva cried. She offered to pay extra to check the second bag, but was told only credit cards were accepted. Since she is too young to have a credit card, she couldn't pay.

Gordon Robson, 26, killed John Potts, 45, with one punch to the back of the head. The hit was so hard that it made a loud cracking sound. Robson was drunk after his grandfather’s funeral. He punched Potts outside a sports bar in Washington, Tyne and Wear, in November last year. Potts had stepped in to stop a fight. Robson has a history of violent crimes. He was sentenced to three and a half years in prison.

Scoring a goal against your old team and taking a perfect free kick are two of the best feelings in football. Notts County player Ellen White had both happen at the same time on Thursday night. she played against Arsenal in the Women's Super League. In the 26th minute, Notts County got a free kick near the penalty area. Laura Bassett and Alex Greenwood seemed to make a mistake. Bassett almost ran into Greenwood, which caused confusion. Ellen White spun around near the edge of the box and kicked the ball into the corner. This goal was against her former club.

High school girls in China are practicing military-style knife drills. 68 girls, aged 16 to 18, from Huizhou Integrated High School’s 27th March campus are taking part. They shout ““kill, stab, slash, and jab”” while performing eight high-intensity movements. They are trained by Inspector Tan, a former special forces soldier. The knives are not real, but fake ones are used for safety. School official Huang Anruo said, “The daggers are fake.”

We spend about one-third of our lives sleeping. Most people don’t think about what their mind and body needs during this rest time to feel refreshed each day. The Sleep Health Foundation published a study showing that 30 percent of Australians complain about not getting enough sleep every day. According to Chair Professor David Hillman, we must make up for lost sleep to function properly throughout the week. Another study confirms that 30 percent of Australians complain about lack of sleep daily. The average adult needs about eight hours of sleep each night, with a range of seven to nine hours.

A video shows a fight between neighbors in Perth, Australia. It ends with someone getting hurt by a crowbar. The video was posted on Facebook today. It shows an angry woman shouting racist insults at a group of men who appear to be African. She is standing over her fence. Then, the woman goes into her neighbor’s front yard. She holds a metal crowbar, yells at the men, and swings the crowbar at them. The men pick up their own weapons, and a fight starts. The woman yells, “I don’t deal with monkeys. Go away, you f***ing monkeys.”

Valencia’s 19-year-old left back, Jose Luis Gaya, is attracting interest from Manchester City, Arsenal, and Chelsea. These English clubs want to sign him before Real Madrid can. Sportsmail’s Pete Jenson examines the Spanish Under-21 defender. Why are English clubs interested? His release clause is currently £13.5m. Considering that Luke Shaw, who is similar in age and potential, cost £27m, it would be foolish not to be interested; although there would be reservations about his suitability to the Premier League. Jose Luis Gaya (right) in action for Valencia during a La Liga match with Sevilla earlier this season.

Police in Oregon are asking the public for help to find a motorcyclist who saved two teenagers. The incident happened in Salem. a 59 man named Edward West allegedly pointed a gun at the teens and told them, "get ready to die." A stranger on a green motorcycle rode up and hit the gun out of West's hands with his helmet. This allowed the teens to escape. The police want to identify this hero.

Tim Sherwood, the manager of Aston Villa, wants his team captain, Ron Vlaar, to show he can play well again. Vlaar is returning to the team after being injured. Sherwood hopes that Vlaar will help the team, which is currently doing poorly, finish the season strongly. He also warned Vlaar that people might have forgotten how well he played for the Netherlands in the World Cup last year. Even though he missed a penalty during a shoot-out against Argentina, he was still a key player in getting his team to the semi-finals in Brazil. This good performance led to rumors that Manchester United might want to sign him. Now, the club captain is back and ready to help Aston Villa fight against being relegated when they play at Old Trafford on Saturday.

Aston Villa manager Tim Sherwood says he is not worried about the club being sold this summer. He wants to build a team his way next season, if the team stays in the league. The current owner, Randy Lerner, is talking with a potential buyer. If someone else buys the club, people might wonder if Sherwood will keep his job. However, Sherwood is focused on keeping the team in the league. After that, he plans to use the summer break to make long-term changes.

Celtic wants to loan Jason Denayer from Manchester City again next season. But, it might not happen. Manchester City’s manager, Manuel Pellegrini, said that his young players are not ready for the first team. Because of this, players like Denayer might have to come back from their loans to help the team.

Southampton manager Ronald Koeman is waiting to know exactly when Fraser Forster will return from his knee injury before deciding if the club needs to sign another goalkeeper in the summer. Forster had surgery after twisting his knee during a 2-0 win against Burnley two weeks ago. doctors say he could be back in four to twelve months. Koeman does not want to give a specific date for his return and believes current backup Kelvin Davis is good enough. However, he admits that if Forster takes longer to recover, the club may have to find another goalkeeper.

Steve Evans, the manager of Rotherham, was angry on the sidelines because his team, which is in danger of being relegated, lost a close game against Birmingham City in the Sky Bet Championship. The home team, Birmingham, took the lead in the first half with goals from Robert Tesche and Clayton Donaldson. Matt Derbyshire then scored a goal for Rotherham, who are in fourth place. However, around the 5 hour mark, Rob Kiernan made a clumsy mistake and handled the ball near the penalty area while Matt Derbyshire was going for a shot. The referee, Dean Whitestone, did not award a penalty, despite Rotherham's protests. This decision left Evans visibly angry as Birmingham held on to win. Robert Tesche celebrated after scoring the first goal for

Virgil van Dijk, a defender for Celtic, is worried about his chances of playing for the Netherlands national team. The Dutch team has already allowed more goals in five Euro 2016 qualifying matches than they did in their entire World Cup qualifying campaign. Despite this, national team coach Guus Hiddink has not contacted him. Van Dijk was selected for two squads last year, but he was not chosen for the recent match against Turkey, which ended in a 1-1 draw. Instead, he was relaxing in the Arabian Gulf with his teammates. Even though Van Dijk has been playing very well for Celtic, he has not been called up to the Netherlands national team.

Celtic has complained to the SFA about ticket prices for their Scottish Cup semi-final against Inverness at Hampden later this month. The SFA has already been criticized by Inverness fans for scheduling the match for 12.15pm on Sunday, April 18, before the first trains from Inverness arrive in Glasgow. The Parkhead club has now made its feelings known after ticket prices were set at £23 for the North and South stands, with the East Stand being £15 for adults and £5 for concessions.

Paul Murray, the interim chairman of Rangers, said on Thursday that the previous management team is completely responsible for the club being removed from the stock exchange. The team will have to leave the Alternative Investment Market (AIM) because they could not find a new advisor required by the rules. Murray said the new board’s plans for the future are not affected and that planned investments will still happen.

Wayne Rooney and his England teammates were unhappy with how the team started their match in Italy on Tuesday night. The game was a friendly, and it was just nine months since the two teams had played each other at the World Cup. The match took place at the Juventus Stadium in Turin. England had won their last seven games, so people expected them to do well. However, the team, managed by Roy Hodgson, played poorly in the first half. They deservedly lost the first goal when Graziano Pelle scored with a header. The final score was 1-1. During the game, England captain Wayne Rooney told his teammates what to do. Rooney said that he and the rest of the team were upset by their performance in the first half.

Dundee United’s board responded to strong criticism from two major supporters' groups, Arabtrust and the Federation of Dundee United Supporters Clubs. The groups are upset that 25 percent of the £6.3 million paid for players Ryan Gauld, Andrew Robertson, Stuart Armstrong, and Gary Mackay-Steven went to commissions for unnamed parties. They also questioned chairman Stephen Thompson’s claimed investment in the club. The board responded by highlighting their team's recent on-field success.

Kilmarnock will make an official announcement on Friday morning that Gary Locke is their new permanent manager. Locke, 39, will receive a three-year contract. This happens exactly eight weeks after he was first asked to manage the team until the end of the season. Locke replaced Allan Johnston in February as the temporary manager. He has won the support of the new chairman, Jim Mann, and the players. Locke thanked the players on Thursday for their hard work. Locke was previously the manager of Hearts.

Chinese parents are very eager to raise child prodigies, such 10-year-olds who enter university or 4-year-olds who can dance like Michael Jackson. Now, a new basketball star is emerging. A viral video in China shows a young boy with impressive basketball skills that rival many professional players. The 5-year-old, named Mai Zizhuo, has been playing basketball since he was 2½ years old, according to People's Daily Online. The video begins with him making many baskets in a row, then dribing two basketballs while running around.

Bayern Munich will not have David Alaba for the last games of the season. Alaba has a torn knee ligament and will be out for about seven weeks. He got hurt while playing for Austria in a 1-1 tie against Bosnia on Tuesday. Alaba, 22, said he is very sad but hopes to play in the final game of the season. This is his second injury this season; he missed three months earlier with a partial tear in his right knee.

Hull KR has signed experienced Australian player Dane Tilse from the Canberra Raiders to fill the spot left by the retirement of Michael Weyman and the departure of Ryan Bailey.

The 30 forward, who stands 6ft 7in and weighs more than 17st, has signed a two-and-half-year contract with Hull KR (the Robins). He will join the team as soon as he finishes the paperwork after the Raiders agree to release him.

Tilse has played 200 games in Australia. He will work with his old teammate Terry Campese, who is now Hull KR’s captain and recently signed a two-year contract extension.

 Tilse is a direct replacement for Weyman, who retired last month because of an injury.

Mark Burchill, the manager of Livingston football team, thinks that midfielder Darren Cole wants to play in the Petrofac Cup final this Sunday. This game is only one week after the sad death of his cousin, Shaun Cole, in America.

 Darren, who used to play for Rangers when he was young, is grieving for Shaun, who was 22 years old. Shaun was found dead on a street in Miami last weekend, and people believe a driver hit him and drove away. Shaun was a soldier who had served in Afghanistan. He was on holiday in Florida while on leave and had gone to a music festival. He was found on the sidewalk with a head injury, which caused his death. Mark Burchill hopes that Darren will play for his team on Sunday.

Alan Smith strongly denies that Liverpool fans attacked the ambulance he was in after he was seriously injured. The incident happened nine years ago during Manchester United’s 1-0 loss to Liverpool in the FA Cup. Smith broke his leg and dislocated his ankle while trying to stop a free kick from John Arne Riise. At the time, there were reports that fans threw bottles, beer glasses, and stones at the ambulance and even shook the vehicle.

Ronny Deila, the manager of Celtic, confirmed that the club is interested in signing Danny Wilson, the captain of Hearts. Celtic might offer £400,000 for him. Danny Wilson used to play for Rangers and Liverpool. He has one year left on his current contract with Hearts. Ann Budge, who owns Hearts, says the club does not need to sell him. Danny Wilson’s contract ends at the end of the season. Hearts are not in a hurry to sell him.

Ronny Deila, the manager of Celtic, says the team will not risk their chances in the Champions League by playing many away games during pre-season. He blames last summer’s tour of the United States, Austria, and Germany for a 4-1 loss to Legia Warsaw in the qualifying round. The team makes a lot of money from these pre-season games and has also played in Australia and Asia in recent years. Ronny Deila and Nir Bitton left the field after losing to Legia Warsaw. They have not yet decided whether to go to America this July.

Franck Ribery says that rumors about Kevin de Bruyne joining Bayern Munich are wrong. De Bruyne is a forward for Wolfsburg. Some people think he could replace Ribery or Arjen Robben. De Bruyne played for Chelsea for two years. Most of that time was on loan. Now he plays for Wolfsburg, which is second in the league. This season, he has scored nine goals. He also has 16 assists. This is seven more than the next best player. Ribery says De Bruyne is not the right player for Pep Guardiola. De Bruyne is 23 and from Belgium. Ribery says De Bruyne plays differently than he and Robben. They have different skills.

Kelsi Langley, the girlfriend of Arizona State University football player Davon Durant, has taken back her accusation that he abused her. she says she lied because of her mood swings.

Durant was arrested for domestic violence after Langley said he hit her in the face and grabbed her neck during an argument in his car on March 7. Because of the arrest, the university suspended Durant from the football team indefinitely and he might be expelled. Langley and Durant had been dating for 18 months. Durant is a highly recruited player who transferred to ASU from a college in Kansas.

A young boy met his hero, Detroit Tigers pitcher Justin Verlander, at a Starbucks. The boy was wearing a dark blue shirt with Verlander’s name and jersey number, 35, on the back. Verlander took a selfie with the boy, and the photo was posted on his Instagram account.

Eden Hazard admitted that playing so many games for Chelsea and his national team this season might have been too much for him. he was substituted after just 62 minutes in Belgium’s 1-1 win against Israel on Tuesday. Hazard has played 48 games this season for his club and country, missing only five matches for Chelsea while helping them win the Premier League title. However, during Belgium’s difficult 1-0 victory over Israel in the European Championship qualifying Group B, manager Marc Wilmots brought him off with 28 minutes left because he had trouble getting past his opponent, Orel Dgani.

Police in the Northern Territory found 20 grams of marijuana hidden inside a leg of lamb. The meat was sent to a company at Darwin Airport, and it was supposed to be shipped to the Tiwi Islands, which are 100 kilometers north. The police smelled something suspicious and decided to x-ray the lamb, which showed the bag of drugs inside.

Former football player Clarke Carlisle has announced that he and his wife, Gemma, are separating. He has moved out of their home in Yorkshire, where they lived for 14 years. Carlisle is struggling with depression after a failed suicide attempt in December. This happened two days after he was arrested for suspected drunk driving.

Paul Merson, a former Arsenal player, was forced to take back his comments after criticizing Andros Townsend’s call-up to the England team. Merson admitted he was wrong. Andros Townsend, who plays for Tottenham, came off the bench and scored a great goal to tie the game 1-1 against Italy in Turon on Tuesday. This was a perfect response to what Merson had written in his Sky Sports column, where he said, "If Andros Townsend can get in (the England squad) then it opens it up for anybody." Andros Townsend scored England's equalizer in their 1-1 friendly draw with Italy in Turon on Tuesday night. Townsend celebrates his strike with Tottenham Hotspur team-mates Ryan Mason (left) and Kyle Walker. In his column

Cesc Fabregas, a midfielder for Chelsea, has a reputation for playing poorly in the second half of the season. He was one of the worst players on the field during Spain’s 2-0 loss to Holland on Tuesday. The 27-year player said he was happy to be playing in southwest London earlier this week, but his performance has dropped significantly from what it was around Christmas. At that time, he looked like he would definitely break the Barclays Premier League record for assists.

West Midlands Police arrested six people in Dover this morning. They are suspected of terrorism offenses related to Syria. Five men and one woman were taken into custody around 8 a.m. at the port’s departure area.

Four of the men are in their 20s and live in Birmingham, in the West Midlands. The other two suspects are a 26-year-old man and a 23-year-old woman who do not have a fixed address.

 The six suspects are currently being questioned at a police station in the West Midlands.

People are likely to buy treats today at 12:52 pm. A study says that people in Britain spend an average of £62 a week on rewards. This spending is highest at lunchtime. The rewards can be anything from a bar of chocolate to a glass of wine, or even designer clothes and shoes. The research was done by the website VoucherCodes.co.uk. The study shows that men spend one third more a month on rewards than women.

Arsene Wenger is very respected and known for being smart. When he speaks, people often agree with him. But, when you look closely, his ideas are not very strong. Usually, he talks about how Arsenal’s defense is actually very good, which is true. But last week, he talked about a new rule. This rule was suggested by Greg Dyke, the head of the Football Association. The rule would change the number of homegrown players allowed in a Premier League team’s 25-player squad. It would increase the number from eight to twelve.

Charlie Austin said that his close friend Joey Barton ignored him on his first day at Queens Park Rangers. Barton realized his mistake, and the two became good friends. Austin had a memorable first season in the Premier League, scoring 15 goals. People think he might play for England in the future. Although Austin and Barton are well-known for being close friends, their first meeting was difficult for Austin.

This dog is his owner’s best friend because he saved him from a cold, muddy grave. The black dog was filmed bringing a rescue rope to his owner at the Clarence J. Brown Dam and Reservoir in Springfield, Ohio, on Saturday afternoon. The video shows firefighters pulling the man to shore after he spent nearly two hours in water that was near freezing (0 degrees Celsius). The man apparently got stuck waist deep in mud while trying to get some duck hunting gear. He was lucky to have a cell phone to call 911. However, firefighters could not send a boat to him because the river was too shallow.

Juventus coach Massimiliano Allegri says he knows that the fans won’t fully support him until the team wins a championship. He took the job last summer, a few months after he was fired from AC Milan. Since then, he has done a great job, leading Juventus to a strong position in the race for the Serie A title. Allegri, who replaced Antonio Conte last summer, will try to get three more points this Saturday when Juventus plays Empoli at home. The Juventus manager is seen directing his team from the sideline, and his team is currently number one in Serie A.

Nathan Redmond scored the winning goal just six minutes into the match. Steven Whittaker passed the ball to Redmond along the right side of the field. Redmond ran faster than defender Joe Bennett and sent a low cross into the box. Bradley Johnson scored by hitting the ball into the net at the back post. This goal won the game for his team at the Amex Stadium.

The residents of Celoron, New York, are upset about a statue of Lucille Ball, a famous person from their town. The statue has not been popular for the last six years. When the town showed the statue in 2009, people were shocked and horrified because the face looked nothing like the beloved comedian. The statue looks so bad that a Facebook page called "We Love Lucy! Get Rid of this Statue" has more than 600 supporters. Some residents call the statue "monstrous." The statue is based on a famous scene from her TV show "I Love Lucy," where she sells a health tonic while drunk.

South Sydney rugby league player Issac Luke, 27, is facing accusations of being homophobic. He posted an offensive comment on social media after being attacked by fans of the Canterbury Bulldogs. On Saturday, Luke posted a sincere message on his official Instagram account, trying to find a young South Sydney fan who was allegedly attacked at ANZ Stadium in Sydney. The player wanted to give the boy a jersey before the Easter holiday weekend to make up for the incident, which left the boy in the hospital after a controversial game.

People who are afraid of spiders, watch out. this story is scary. A man in Victoria, Australia, was very surprised when a large huntsman spider came out from inside his car door handle. The video was recorded in Wangaratta, in northeast Victoria. It starts with the man walking up to his black Holden Ute and spraying insect repell on the door. The driver spr his car with insect repell, which made the huntsman spider come out from under the door handle. He calmly said, “Get out, you bastard.” But when the hairy legs of the huntsman spider came out, the man did not seem calm. He yelped and moved back in fear.

Tottenham’s manager, Mauricio Pochettino, says that Harry Kane is like Gabriel Batistuta, a famous soccer player. Pochettino promised to support Kane when he is having difficult times. Kane recently scored a goal in his first game for the England national team. This happened 79 seconds after he came into the game against Lithuania at Wembley Stadium. This goal means Kane is now only two goals away from scoring 30 goals this season. Roy Hodgson, the England manager, wants to keep expectations low for Kane. Kane has risen quickly in his career. This happened after he finally joined the Tottenham first team, following time spent playing for other teams like Leicester and Norwich.

A former professional footballer, Michael McIndoe, who played for Bristol City and Wolverhampton Wanderers, is now living in poverty. a court was told. McIndoe ran a £30 million investment scheme that promised a 20 20 percent return. He convinced other footballers to join. The scheme failed because of large debts. McIndoe went bankrupt last October with over £2 million in debt. He was known as "Mr Big" in Marbella, where he part with beautiful women. Now, people he owes money are suing him in court.

Pavel Nedved, a director at Juventus, said that Barcelona wants to sign Paul Pogba. Nedved gave an interview to the newspaper Mundo Deportivo. He said Pogba will not be leaving Juventus. Nedved also said he was happy that Juventus did not play against Barcelona in the quarter-finals of the Champions League.

James Oliver, 44, is a convicted sex offender. Linda Currier, 53, is his girlfriend. She allegedly hit him with her car after she saw him trying to abuse a 12-year-old girl.

 Police found Oliver with a serious leg injury in the driveway of a house in Noblesboro, Maine, on Saturday night.

 According to police, Currier and Oliver argued inside the house. this happened after Currier caught him trying to sexually assault the young girl.

Brendan Rodgers, the manager of Liverpool, wants to sign a goalkeeper named Neto from Fiorentina. PSG (Paris Saint-Germain) and several clubs in Spain also want to sign him. Neto’s agent, Stefano Castagna, says that Liverpool has strong competition for him. Earlier this season, when Liverpool’s other goalkeeper, Simon Mignolet, was not playing, people thought Liverpool might sign Neto. Neto is 25 years and his contract ends in June. Liverpool tried to sign him in January, but that did not happen. Now, it seems very likely that Neto will leave Fiorentina in the summer.

A video by YouTuber Richard Stewart shows a Porsche Cayman losing control on Prince Edward Island, Canada. The car speeds away from a green light, swerves wildly, and crashes into a concrete median. A wheel comes off before the car stops. Stewart says, "Just having a nice car doesn't make you a good driver. Don't let your son drive your Porsche!"

This weekend, Sportsmail will provide information for every Premier League game, including team news, possible lineups, betting odds, and statistics from Opta. Here is the information for Sunderland’s home game against Newcastle at the Stadium of Light.

Sunderland midfielder Lee Cattermole will return to the starting team for Sunday’s match against Newcastle. Head coach Dick Advocaat confirmed that Cattermole is eligible to play after serving a two-match ban. The ban was due to Cattermole receiving his 10th booking of the season.

If Rory McIlroy wins the upcoming Masters, it will make him the first golfer to win all four major championships. This achievement will the end of a long journey for the world’s top golfer. He has worked with his sponsor, Bose, to make a video that shows his life from playing golf as a child to becoming a star, including some difficult times. The video starts with McIlroy going for a run early in the morning, with the words “Six weeks to Georgia” on the screen. It also includes an interview with McIlroy when he was young, before he became famous.

Sergio Garcia says he is only thinking about winning his first PGA Tour event since 2012 at this week’s Shell Houston Open. The Masters golf tournament is coming up soon, but he is not distracted by it. Rory McIlroy is trying to win three major tournaments in a row to complete his career Grand Slam. Also, everyone is wondering if Tiger Woods will return to playing after taking time away from the game. These topics have been the main news for weeks. The Golf Club of Houston is set up to look like the course at Augusta, but Garcia is focused on ending his long wait for a win.

Riki Hughes, a 31-year-old Iraq war veteran, went to jail for 16 months. He worked as a volunteer club secretary for Tidworth Town Football Club. He stole £17,000 from the club. The money was spent on camping gear and a bachelor party trip to Las Vegas. Hughes told people he was paying rent for the club’s building. In reality, the club was using the building for free.

Johnny Sexton is used to winning. He has won many gold medals and now he wants to keep winning. He prepared for a big game against Saracens in Paris on Sunday. Sexton plays for Racing Metro and is also famous for playing for Ireland. He said, “I have been lucky to play with great teams for Leinster and Ireland. I have won trophies almost every year.” The is 29 years. The is only one year, 2010, when he did not win any big awards.

Mustafa Kamal stepped down as president of the International Cricket Council (ICC) on Wednesday. He is from Bangladesh. He said that India had influence in the ICC and used that power to change the result of the quarter-final match between India and Bangladesh.

Kamal spoke at the airport after returning from the tournament in Australia. He said, "Everyone saw what happened during the Bangladesh-India match. India has influenced the outcome of the match using its position (in the ICC."

He added, "From now on, I am a former president of the ICC. I would have reacted similarly had it happened to any other country."

Kamal, pictured with the Cricket World Cup trophy, has stepped down as ICC President.

West Ham manager Sam Allardyce supports Nigel Pearson, the manager of Leicester City. Allardyce thinks Pearson is independent and strong-minded. Allardyce worked with Pearson at Newcastle United in 277. They will work together again when West Ham plays Leicester at the King Power Stadium on Saturday. Pearson has been involved in many arguments this season. These include grabbing Crystal Palace player James McArthur by the neck and getting angry with a reporter during a press conference.

Sunderland’s manager, John O'Shea, told his team to take control of their fate by beating Newcastle for the fifth game in a row. The two teams play at the Stadium of Light on Sunday. Sunderland has won the last four games against Newcastle, but they really need these three points to stay away from the fight to avoid being promoted to the Premier League. O'Shea and his players could end up in the releg zone if Burnley beats Tottenham in the earlier game that day. and that would make getting three points very important.

Stoke City manager Mark Hughes believes his team should finally win a game at Chelsea’s stadium, Stamford Bridge. Since Stoke promoted to the Premier League in 208, they have played Chelsea away eight times in all competitions and lost every time. The last time Stoke won at Chelsea’s ground was in 1995, when they won a League Cup match. Since a 1-1 tie in 1984, Stoke has not earned a single point in a game at Chelsea. Hughes says his team must end this losing streak. Chelsea recently beat Stoke 3-0, with Frank Lampard celebrating the victory.

Newcastle United wants to avoid losing their third game in a row when they play their rivals, Sunderland, on Sunday. They have been having a hard time lately because their star striker, Papiss Cisse, is banned. Dick Advocaat’s team is at the bottom of the Premier League, just one point above the teams that might have to leave the league. But if it weren’t for Cisse’s goals, Sunderland would actually be two points worse off than Newcastle. Cisse is Newcastle’s best scorer this year with 11 goals. 10 of those goals helped Newcastle win games.

Dick Advocaat, the manager of Sunderland, is happy to have Lee Cattermole back playing in the middle of the team. He wants to use this chance to save the team from being relegated. Cattermole is 27 and known for playing toughly. He missed the last two games because he was suspended. He had received 10 yellow cards this season. Tottenham defender Ben Davies is focused on the game and not on personal feelings when he plays against his Wales teammate, Sam Vokes, at Burnley on Sunday.

Burnley, meanwhile, is fighting to stay in the league. They are currently in 18th place, but only one point away from safety. Earlier this season, Sam Vokes scored for Burnley against Tottenham in the FA Cup. Ben Davies looked upset when Burnley tied the game in that match at Turf Moor.

Neil Redfearn, the manager of Leeds United, is thinking about staying in his job. this is because the club suspended his assistant, Steve Thompson, on Thursday. It took Leeds two months to hire Thompson, but he received a letter from the director of football, Nicola Salerno, yesterday morning. The letter said he was suspended until the end of the season. This effectively ends his time at the club after only 105 days. It is understood that Thompson was told he would be suspended until his contract ends at the end of the season. John Carver says he will push his Newcastle players hard if he has to, to get them ready for Sunday’s game against Sunderland at the Stadium of Light. Newcastle has lost the last four games to Sunderland. Carver, who was Alan Pardew’s assistant during those losses, admits that Sunderland wanted to win more than Newcastle did. “Sunderland worked harder than us in the last four games, and that’s not a good thing,” he said.

David Templeton, a player for Rangers, said that the previous coaches, Ally McCoist and Kenny McDowall, did not good enough job training the team. He said that Stuart McCall, the new coach, has brought better coaching and game plans. Templeton said McCall has done a great job since he started last month. The team has won two games in a row, which has made the players feel more confident. This is good news before they play Hearts, who are winning the Championship, this Saturday.

Celta Vigo player Nolito says Lionel Messi should stay home from the game on Sunday instead of risking hurting his foot again. Messi has been practicing with his minor foot problem and should be ready to play when Barcelona travels to Celta. Nolito, 28, told the newspaper Marca that he thinks Messi will come, but he would rather see him relax at the beach. Nolito joked that he would call Messi’s father. Messi is expected to be healthy for the match against Celta Vigo. Messi was seen training with his teammate Javier Mascherano on Thursday.

Hearts manager Robbie Neilson says that players like captain Danny Wilson will only leave the club if it is the right decision for the team. Sportsmail reported this week that Celtic has put former Rangers defender Wilson on their list of potential summer signings. Neilson admitted that it is expected that outside clubs will show interest in his promoted players before Sunday’s match against Celtic. However, he agrees with owner Ann Budge that players will only be sold if Neilson approves and the price is right.

Sam Allardyce, the manager of West Ham, told Brendan Rodgers, the manager of Liverpool, that giving Raheem Sterling a very high-paying new contract might cause problems with the rest of the Liverpool team. Allardyce thinks that if Sterling gets paid more than the £100,000 per week he was already offered, his teammates will ask for more money too. Allardyce does not blame Sterling for trying to get the highest pay possible, because Sterling currently earns £35,000 a week at Liverpool. Blackpool Football Club is talking to Thomas Piermayr, a 25 defender from Austria, about signing him. He has been training with the team this week. Blackpool wants to hire him because they expect to play in League One next season. Piermayr is currently a free agent, which means he does not have a current team. He used to play for the Colorado Rapids. He also played for Inverness Caledonian Thistle in 2211. He has never played in England, but Blackpool might be his first chance to play there.

Tony Pulis plans to talk with West Bromwich Albion chairman Jeremy Peace after the team is safe from relegation in the Premier League. Pulis wants the club to become a top-ten team again. He said that West Brom has "gone off the rails" in recent seasons and needs major changes to get back on track. The team finished 10th and 8th under Roy Hodgson and Steve Clarke. Last season, they struggled and finished 17th. Tony Pulis, the manager of West Bromwich Albion, was seen shouting instructions from the sideline during a game against Manchester City.

Arsenal legend Ian Wright is upset that Theo Walcott is leaving north London. Wright thinks Walcott’s struggles at the club are because manager Arsene Wenger refused to play him as a striker. Walcott has started only five games for Arsenal this season after returning from a serious knee injury that kept him out for seven months. With Arsenal looking at signing Raheem Sterling and Walcott’s contract ending next summer, Wright is worried that the team might lose a valuable player.

Roberto Martinez, the manager of Everton, believes Ross Barkley will become a more important player for both his club and the England national team. after overcoming a difficult second season. Barkley has had a mixed season for Everton. This was partly because he was selected for England’s World Cup team last summer and partly because a knee surgery delayed his return to playing. Despite this, England’s coach, Roy Hodgson, still trusts the 21-year-old. Martinez thinks Barkley’s two recent appearances as a substitute for England against Lithuania and Italy show that he is ready to improve his performance.

England’s Under-19 soccer team will not play in the European Championships this summer. They lost 2-1 to France in their final qualifying match. The team had previously beaten Denmark and Azerbaijan, so they needed to win against France in Saint-Lo to reach the finals in Greece in July. France took the lead with goals from Sehrou Guirassy and Gnaly Cornet. England’s Patrick Roberts scored a late goal, but it was not enough to help his team, managed by Sean O’Driscoll, qualify.

Jonas Gutierrez, a 31-year-old midfielder for Newcastle, wants to help his team beat Sunderland, their rivals, in an important upcoming match. Gutierrez recently returned to playing after recovering from testicular cancer. He has come off the bench in Newcastle's last three games and has been warmly welcomed back by his teammates and fans. unfortunately, Newcastle lost all three of those matches. Gutierrez is eager to stop this losing streak. Newcastle is trying to recover from four losses in a row, and they will play Sunderland at Sunderland's home stadium, the Stadium of Light, on Sunday.

During a close rugby league match on Good Friday at ANZ Stadium in Sydney, South Sydney (the Rabbitohs) beat Canterbury (the Bulldogs) 18-17 with a last-minute try. The game was controversial because referees penalized Bulldogs captain James Graham in the final moments, which gave the win to the Rabbitohs. After the game, as officials and players were leaving the field, some angry fans threw plastic water bottles and shouted insults at them.

Kevin Sinfield, the former captain of the England rugby league team, was told that he will be a "target" when he moves to rugby union. Sinfield, 34, is considered the best captain in Leeds' history. He surprised the rugby league world on Tuesday by announcing that he will leave the sport at the end of the season. He will join Yorkshire Carnegie, which is connected to Leeds Rhinos, on an 18-month contract.

Raheem Sterling said he is not ready to sign a new contract with Liverpool. despite being offered £100,000 a week. The 20-year-old is getting closer to leaving Anfield. He told the BBC on Wednesday that he would have signed for less money a year ago. Even though he is one of Liverpool’s best players, Sterling has not played as well as he did last season. He has scored only six goals this season—one fewer than Stoke’s Jon Walters. his goal scoring rate and time per goal have both gotten worse, as the graphic shows.

Brighton and Hove Albion, a football team in the Championship league, is the first club to offer legal and ethical training on sexual consent to its young players. The BBC reports that the club is also providing counseling through this initiative. The program, called Protect, Inform and Prevent (PIP), teaches players about the legal definition of consent. The training includes confidential question and answer sessions where players can discuss past experiences. These sessions are led by a former police detective and a psychotherapist.

A new video made by Leo Burnett Toronto for the charity Humans For Humans shows homeless people reading mean tweets about themselves. The video is meant to make people think twice about how they treat homeless people. Many of the people cry as they read comments like, "I hate the homeless, I don’t feel sorry for you" and "I saw a homeless girl across the street. I almost vomited."

George Boyd is the most active player in the Barclays Premier League this season. He has run a total of 210.5 miles on the field. This distance is the same as running from Burnley’s Turf Moor stadium to Crystal Palace’s Selhurst Park in south London. Boyd has run slightly farther than Christian Eriksen, who plays for Tottenham Hotspur. According to Google Maps, it would normally take 69 hours to walk from Turf Moor to Selhurst Park. Boyd has covered this distance in less than 40 hours of playing time.

Police in Birmingham have arrested the parents of a five-month-old baby girl after she died. The father, 25, and the mother, 25, who live in Perry Barr, were taken into custody yesterday afternoon.

The police were called to their home just before 1 a.m. yesterday because the baby was having trouble breathing. The baby was taken to Birmingham Children's Hospital, but she died a few hours later.

 A police spokesman said the death is being treated as suspicious. A post-mort exam will happen today to find out exactly how the baby died.

Gordon Taylor, the head of the players' union, says Raheem Sterling is not being disloyal to Liverpool by delaying contract talks until the summer. The 20-year-old English player has received a huge offer from manager Brendan Rodgers, which is believed to be £100,000 per week. However, negotiations have reached a deadlock. Sterling has said he is not just interested in money, and Taylor thinks it is smart to wait until the season ends before continuing the discussions. Sterling admitted in a TV interview that he is not ready to sign a new contract with Liverpool.

It has been a difficult time for former Manchester United player Anderson since he returned to Brazil. On Wednesday, his own mistakes were overshadowed by a teammate’s foolish behavior. Anderson was sent off during the first half of a match for Internacional. He pushed an opposing player, Otacilio Neto, while the ball was not in play. Neto was also sent off for hitting Anderson with his elbow.

However, Anderson’s teammate, Fabricio, drew more attention by yelling at his own fans. Fabricio was also given a red card. This meant Internacional had only nine players on the field for the 1-1 tie in Porto Alegre.

A seven-year-old boy was attacked by two teenagers while he was out buying food. The two youths took the boy to a remote place and raped him. When the boy fought back, they set him on fire, Inspector Sasthe told PTI. The boy, who had burns covering 30 percent of his body, managed to get away, Sasthe added. The shocking incident happened in Pagma Nagar, a area in Bhiwandi City, which is a suburb of Mumbai. The police are investigating the incident, which took place in Padma Nagar in the city of Bhiwandi, a suburb of Mumbai, police said today.

Dug, a pug, has recovered after being bitten in the face by a rattlesnake. Dug and his owner, Lindsay Castro, were hiking on the Jurupa Hills trail in Fontana, Canada, on Thursday. They heard a rattling sound. Lindsay moved back, but Dug ran toward the snake and was bitten. Dug’s face swed up to twice its normal size.

Alvaro Arbeloa, a defender for Real Madrid, says that Jose Mourinho could return to manage the team in the future. Mourinho was the manager of Chelsea at the time. He left Real Madrid in 23 after three years to go back to Chelsea. When he left, there were rumors that he had fights with important players, like Iker Casillas, Sergio Ramos, and Pepe. Arbeloa says that Real Madrid will always be open to hiring Mourinho again as their coach.

On Saturday, Liverpool’s hopes of reaching the Champions League ended at the Emirates Stadium. Manager Brendan Rodgers admitted this during his 15-minute press conference. It was clear that missed opportunities had cost them.

 Rodgers tried to stay positive. He never looks sad or defeated, but he admitted that this has been a difficult season. Last year, Liverpool fought hard for the title, but this year they have fallen out of the race. It is a hard reality for a club that thought it was returning to greatness. Even so, it still feels like Liverpool are moving forward under Rodgers.

Inter Milan coach Roberto Mancini was angry because his team drew 1-1 at home against Parma, a team near the bottom of the league. He cancelled their day off and made them come to training early on Sunday morning. The team trained at 8:30 a.m. local time. Club vice-president Javier Zanetti and sporting director Piero Ausilio watched the practice. Mancini was upset with his players’ attitude. The draw left Inter tied for ninth place with Genoa, 10 points behind the spots that qualify for European competitions. Inter confirmed on their website that the first team trained at 8:30 a.m. on Easter Sunday.

Many fans want to buy rare items that used to belong to their favorite players or teams. small pieces of history can sell for thousands of pounds. You might be surprised to learn that an expired passport of Paul Parker was listed on eBay for £5,000. Paul Parker was a well-known right-back for Manchester United and England in the 1990s. The listing started in early March and the bidding ended on Tuesday. It is not clear if anyone actually paid the high price.

People have seen images of Jesus on toast, pancakes, crisps, and ice cream. But a builder named Paddy Morrall was surprised when he saw a image of Jesus on a piece of wood just before Easter. Paddy, who is 31 and works as a builder from Keighley near Bradford, found the image on a broken scaffolding board in Inverness, Scotland, on Wednesday. The image showed Jesus wearing a robe. It appeared after Paddy and his coworkers left the wood outside in the rain for several hours. Paddy has kept the board.

On Tuesday, Slovakia beat the Czech Republic 1-0 in a friendly soccer match. Ondrej Duda scored the only goal in the second half. The 20-year-old midfielder kicked a low shot from outside the penalty box in the 49th minute. This was his second goal for his country.

This was Slovakia’s third win in 10 games against the Czech Republic since the two countries split in 1993. The Czech Republic has won five of those games. During the match, Slovakia’s Martin Skrtel hit Czech player Daniel Kolar in the face with a high kick. Slovakia’s win continued their good recent performance.

Karim Benzema, a star player for Real Madrid, showed that he has other talents besides football. He posted a video of himself rapping along to a song by Tupac while driving his expensive car, a Bugatti Veyron. The video was shared just before Real Madrid plays Granada at their home stadium, the Bernabeu, on Sunday. Benzema sang along to Tupac’s song "Check Out Time." Some people think Tupac’s song "All Eyez on Me" would have fit him better, since Benzema has already scored 20 goals this season in all competitions.

Harvey Boulter, a wealthy businessman who supports UKIP, is trying to stop a Conservative candidate named Tom Tugendhat from winning an election. Boulter is known for forcing Liam Fox to quit his job as Defence Secretary. He is angry at Fox and is continuing his fight against him. Boulter has already given £30,000 to the UKIP candidate who is running against Fox in Somerset. Now, Boulter is spending another £30,000 to help defeat Tom Tugendhat, who is running for the Conservatives in Tonbridge and West Malling, Kent.

The game between Sheffield Wednesday and Huddersfield, which was called a Yorkshire derby, ended in a 1-1 tie. Two goals were scored in the last four minutes of the match. Sergiu Bus, who came on as a substitute for Sheffield Wednesday, scored the first goal in the 86th minute. Ishmael Miller, also a substitute, scored an equal goal for Huddersfield just before the end of the game. This result means Huddersfield has not won any of their last seven games. They are now 18th in the league table, six places and nine points behind Sheffield Wednesday. Sergiu Bus is shown celebrating after scoring for Sheffield Wednesday against Huddersfield.

Stuart Dallas has come a long way since Mark Warburton signed him from a local park for £70 a week. The 23-year-old, who recently played well for Northern Ireland, scored two excellent goals as Brentford beat Fulham 4-1 on Good Friday. Brentford is now aiming for more than just a spot in the play-offs. It was three years ago when Warburton saw Dallas playing part-time on a muddy field for Crusaders, back home. Stuart Dallas celebrated his second great goal against Fulham on Good Friday. Dallas has been a surprise success this season as he helps Brentford push toward the Premier League.

Baseball is America’s most popular hobby, so it’s no surprise that fans are very passionate about their favorite teams. The New York Yankees and Boston Red Sox are the biggest rivals, and they also have the most fans, ranking first and second, respectively. The Texas Rangers and Atlanta Braves also have many fans, especially in the South. However, some teams, like the New York Mets, have fewer fans.

Trey Moses, a high school basketball star, made many people happy by asking a girl named Ellie Meredith to prom. Ellie has Down syndrome. Trey is a senior at Eastern High School in Louisville, Kentucky. He will play basketball for Ball State University next year.

Trey volunteers with teenagers who have learning disabilities. During Ellie’s P.E. class, he surprised her with flowers and a sign. The sign said: "Let's Party Like it's 1989." This is a reference to a Taylor Swift album, because Ellie loves her music. Ellie said yes. She told CNN that she can’t wait to go dress shopping because she has already told many people.

On April Fools' Day, President Barack Obama took a break from his duties to pretend to be Frank Underwood, the fictional president from the TV show *House of Cards*. Underwood is a tricky character played by Kevin Spacey, who won an Oscar. and often talks directly to the audience in a style like Shakespeare. Obama turned his head, as Underwood does, and said, "Hello everybody. This is not Frank Underwood. This is Barack Obama. Happy April Fools' Day. Frank learned it from me." He also used a Southern accent to sound like Underwood.

Ludovic Obraniak, a midfielder for Caykur Rizespor, was taken to the hospital on Saturday because doctors worried about his heart. He was substituted from the game against Fenerbahce after playing only 30 minutes. The team said on social media that he was not in immediate danger after initial tests. Obraniak is currently playing for Rizespor on loan from the German team Werder Bremen. Moussa Sow scored a goal for Fenerbahce, which won the match 5-1.

On Easter Sunday night, a crash occurred on Warringah Road in Frenchs Forest, northern Sydney. A 1973 E-Type Jaguar, worth more than $120,000, collided head-on with a Toyota Kluger 4WD at a traffic light intersection. The Jaguar was destroyed in the accident. Three adults were taken to the hospital as a precaution, even though no one was injured. NSW police are still investigating the crash.

People in Shandong Province, China, have been carrying natural gas in plastic bags. Recent pictures from Lijin village in Dongying city show people using rickshaws to move bags of gas that can be up to six metres long. The People’s Daily Online reported this. Passers-by are worried because this looks like carrying a bomb. If the gas touches a flame or even a cigarette, it could cause a big disaster. This is a common sight in some villages in Shandong. Local media say this is a way for villages to save money on gas transport.

Tiger Woods was seen practicing at Augusta National, which gives fans hope that he will play in this year’s Masters, the first major golf tournament of the season. Woods has not played on the PGA Tour since February 5, when he quit the Farmers Insurance Open because of his back pain came back. He has taken time away from the game to try to get better, but many people think he will come back for the Masters, which he has won four times. Woods was seen practicing at Augusta on Tuesday, and it is said that he has returned to the course. Woods has fallen out of the top 100 in the world rankings for the first time in almost 19 years.

The BBC is facing criticism for spending thousands of pounds of licence fee payers' money on a 44-page guide for staff on how to use emojis. The guide was commissioned by BBC executives, who hired an agency to research how smiley faces could be used in news stories and on social media. Emoji designers were also asked to create graphics of popular stars, such as Gary Lineker and Graham Norton. The BBC spent licence fee payers' money on the emoji guide before using a 'sad face' emoticon to describe the death of the world's oldest woman.

Moses Kipsiro, a top distance runner who often trains with Mo Farah, says he is afraid for his life. Kipsiro won the 10,000 title at the Commonwealth Games in Glasgow last year. He told Sportsmail that five female runners came to him for help. They said a coach was sexually abusing them, some as young as 15. Kipsiro reported the abuse to the police and his national running federation. Since then, he has received death threats.

Patrick Kluivert, a former Dutch football player and assistant coach, has started his job as head coach of Curacao with a win. Curacao, an island in the Caribbean, moved on to the next round of World Cup qualifying for CONCACAF (the region that includes North America, Central America, and the Caribbean) for the 2018 World Cup. The team tied 2-2 in the second game against Montserrat, which meant they won 4-3 overall. Kluivert’s team had already won 2-1 on Saturday in Willemstad. Brady Eaves, an 18-year-old student, has been kicked out of his fraternity, dropped from college, and sent for a mental health evaluation. after a video showed him biting the head off a live hameter. DailyMail.com revealed last weekend that Eaves, the stepson of a former Mississippi governor candidate who went to private school, was the teenager laughing while killing the small animal in a video from a drunken Spring Break party. The video, said to be filmed in Florida, could lead to felony animal cruelty charges against Eaves, which have a maximum jail sentence of five years and a $555 fine.

Sri Lanka’s sports minister, Navin Dissanayake, asked cricketer Kumar Sangakkara to reconsider his retirement from limited-overs cricket. He suggested that Sangakkara should play for one more year. Sangakkara announced he was retiring from one-day cricket on March 18. This decision came after Sri Lanka lost a World Cup quarter-final match. Sangakkara said he was happy because the team is in a better position now than when he started playing for them in 2000. The sports minister made this request after naming a new temporary group to manage the sport. led by former test player Sidath Wettimuny.

Edinburgh Rugby has called back three Scottish players for their European Challenge Cup quarter-final match against London Irish this Sunday. Dougie Fife, Alasdair Dickinson, and Ross Ford were rested from last week’s 26-15 Pro12 victory over the Scarlets in Llanelli. They had just played for Scotland in the Six Nations tournament. Head coach Alan Solomons has brought them back for the game at the Madejski Stadium because he wants to field his strongest team. Fife is one of three Scottish players returning to Edinburgh after playing for their national team.

Chris Ramsey, the manager of QPR, says that Tony Pulis is one of the best coaches in Britain. but Ramsey’s team does not need to learn any tactics from him. QPR plays against Pulis’s West Brom on Saturday. QPR is currently 19th in the Premier League, four points behind 17th-place Sunderland. QPR has earned only four points since the start of the year. They need a finish like Pulis had with Crystal Palace in 213-14. With Palace, Pulis earned 17 points in the last eight games to avoid being relegated.

Silhan Ozcelik, an 18-year-old student, appeared in court accused of planning to travel abroad to fight with Kurdish rebels against the Islamic State. The court heard that she went missing from her Kurdish family’s home in north London last October when she was 17. Ozcelik traveled on the Eurostar with another man to Stuttgart, Germany, where the Kurdish Workers’ Party (PKK) youth movement has its headquarters. Ozcelik, 18, is accused of preparing to commit a terrorist act in October 214.

Esteban Cambiasso, who plays for Leicester City, has won many important football trophies before. He says that keeping Leicester in the Premier League would be one of the best moments of his career. Cambiasso, who used to play for the Argentina national team, won five league titles with Inter Milan and also won the Champions League in 20010. He told the BBC that avoiding relegation feels like winning another cup. He joined Leicester last summer for free money and signed a one-year contract at their stadium, the King Power Stadium.

Crystal Palace manager Alan Pardew says Manchester City can still win the Premier League title, even if they are behind. City came back to win the league last season, and they also won in 212 thanks to a last-minute goal by Sergio Aguero. Chelsea is currently six points ahead of the other teams, but they have one game left to play. Pardew, whose team plays against City on Monday, believes the title race is not over yet. Pardew has said that City still has a chance to win the title.

Hull City has asked the Football Association (FA) to change its name back to Hull Tigers. The FA had previously said no, by 47 votes to 27. This made many fans angry because they thought the club would keep its current name. However, the team’s manager, Steve Bruce, said the club is trying again. If the club’s owner, Assem Allam, gets his way, the team will be called Hull Tigers. Even though fans are upset, Allam still wants to change the name. A group of judges has now allowed Allam to make another application.

He can create amazing images by using his touch. He uses a special technique: he applies fabric paint to create an outline, and then he colors in the work.

Costa hurt his hamstring during Chelsea’s recent win over Hull and missed time with the Spanish national team.
