Rangers have lost all three league games against teams from Edinburgh this season. Stuart McCall, who manages Hearts, thinks his team should win at least one game when they visit Ibrox on Sunday. Hearts won 2-1 there last August, and Hibernian won 3-1 and 2-0 on their visits. McCall wants to change the record and get a win. Rangers did win 2-0 against Hearts recently, which might have helped them improve their chances of moving up to a higher league.

Celtic, who are trying to win three major trophies this season, played against St Mirren, who are struggling near the bottom of the league. many people thought this match would be boring. But, even though Celtic won, the game showed that they will not easily win their fourth title in a row. Celtic winger Kris Commons took a shot on goal during the match on Friday.

Ulster has signed Charles Piutau, a player from New Zealand. Piutau, 23, will join the team in July 2016 for two years. He can play as a full back, wing, or centre. Piutau has played for the All Blacks, New Zealand's national team, 14 times. He made his first international game against France two years ago. He has played for the Blues, a New Zealand team, since 212. Bryn Cunningham, Ulster's team manager, said it is very exciting to get a player with Piutau's skills.

On a rainy day, Fiorentina beat Sampdoria 2-0. This win moved Fiorentina up to fourth place in the league with 49 points. Alessandro Diamanti, a former West Ham player, scored the first goal just after the 60th minute. Mohamed Salah, who plays for Fiorentina on loan from Chelsea, scored the second goal two minutes later.

 Miralem Pjanic scored the only goal to help AS Roma beat Napoli 1-0. This was Roma’s first home win in over four months. Mohamed Salah scored again, continuing his streak of goals. The image shows Salah turning away after scoring Fiorentina’s second goal in their 2-0 victory over Sampdoria.

Juventus won 2-0 against Empoli on Saturday. This makes it four games in a row that they have been close to winning the Serie A championship. Carlos Tevez scored the first goal just before halftime. Roberto Pereyra scored the second goal at the very end of the game. Juventus is now 14 points ahead of the team in second place. There are nine games left in the season.

Kevin de Bruyne’s agent says that no deal has been made for the player to leave Wolfsburg this summer. However, he admitted that many clubs are watching the Belgian star. De Bruyne has become very popular in European football after playing well in the Bundesliga, and he has been linked with Manchester City and Bayern Munich. Patrick De Koster, his agent, told FOCUS Online that many teams want him, but no transfer has been agreed. He said, “There are always interested teams and there has been some informal contact.”

Swansea manager Garry Monk wants to win his first game of the season against Hull on Saturday. His team has had a great season so far. They are currently in eighth place, which is their best position in the Barclays Premier League. They also have the most points they have ever had at this time of year. Swansea has eight games left to get five more points. If they do, they will beat the 47 points they got in their first season in the Premier League in 2112. Monk wants to get a point after the international break. The Swansea boss was seen pointing at his striker, Bafetimbi Gomis, during a training session this week.

Lionel Messi and Cristiano Ronaldo are famous rivals in modern soccer. Ronaldo, the 2002 World Cup winner, wants them to play on the same team. Ronaldo is a co-owner of the Fort Lauderdale Strikers, a second-division team in the United States. He wants to make his team a major global force. The former Barcelona and Real Madrid striker said he wants the best players in the world to join his club. Ronaldo said he would pay out of his own pocket to sign Lionel Messi. The ex-Brazil and Inter Milan striker’s US team is also trying to sign Cristiano Ronaldo.

Northampton rugby team says that George North, a player for Wales, will not play in the European Champions Cup quarter-final game against Clermont Auvergne on Saturday. He has suffered another head injury. The team is waiting for a doctor’s advice before deciding when he can play again. North has been knocked unconscious three times in recent months, including during last Friday’s game against Wasps, which Northampton won 52-30. On Wednesday, a brain specialist examined him. Jim Mallinder, the rugby director at Northampton, said they will not play North at the weekend. North was lying still on the field after being knocked out during the game against Wasps. Mallinder said that North had a serious injury and was unconscious for a very short time.

Cesar Azpilicueta, a defender for Chelsea, believes his team will win the Barclays Premier League. He says that Chelsea has been the best team since the season started. The team is currently in first place, six points ahead of Manchester City, who are their closest competitors. Chelsea has one more game to play than Manchester City. They will play against Stoke City at their home stadium, Stamford Bridge, on Saturday. People have long thought that Chelsea would win the title because they started the season very strongly. They won seven of their first eight games in August, which put them in first place early on.

Mohamed Diame will return to play for Hull City when they visit Swansea on Saturday. Hull manager Steve Bruce said that Diame, who plays in the middle of the field, will take part in the game at some point. Bruce said, "He will be involved. He is very strong and excellent, but he has been out for four months with a bad knee injury." Diame was bought from West Ham for £3.5 million in the summer. His return is good news for Hull because they are fighting to avoid being relegated from the league.

Atletico Madrid’s sporting director, Jose Luis Perez Caminero, says that 26-yearish Belgian defender Toby Alderweireld will return to the Spanish club when his one-year loan at Southampton ends. Alderweireld has played well for Southampton and has previously said he would like to stay in the Premier League permanently, with Tottenham also interested in him. However, Atletico Madrid expects Alderweireld to come back to their team, along with another player, Oliver Torres, who is currently playing for Porto in Portugal.

Tom Carroll, a footballer for Swansea who is playing there on loan from Tottenham, will be out of action for up to six weeks because of an ankle injury. He damaged his ankle ligaments while playing for the England Under-21 team in their 1-0 win against the Czech Republic last Friday. Carroll scored the only goal in that match, which played in Prague. After he scored the winning goal, his teammates celebrated with him. Carroll has played 18 times for Swansea during his one-year loan from Tottenham.

Franck Ribery says he cannot play for Bayern Munich against Borussia Dortmund this week because he is still recovering from an injury. He admitted that he can barely even run. Ribery got hurt at the start of last month during a game against Shakhtar Donetsk, and had to leave the field liming. In that same game, his teammate Arjen Robben also got hurt.

However, Ribery hopes he will be ready to play in the German Cup quarter-final against Bayer Leverkusen in the middle of the week. The images show Ribery celebrating a goal in the Champions League against Shakhtar Donetsk and being tackled by a defender from Braunschweig.

Bayern Munich captain Philipp Lahm might play in the Bundesliga game against Borussia Dortmund on Saturday. This is his first game since he hurt his ankle. Lahm has now fully recovered from his broken ankle.

 Coach Pep Guardiola said on Friday that several other players cannot play. Midfielders Franck Ribery (with an ankle injury), Arjen Robben (with a stomach problem), Javi Martinez (with a knee injury), and defender David Alaba (with a knee injury) are all out. Guardiola was not sure about defender Holger Badstuber (with a hip injury). He said that midfielder Thiago Alcantara might play for "maybe a few minutes" as he recovers from long-standing knee injuries. Guardiola will be without a number of his first-team stars for his side

Michael Duff, a long-serving defender for Burnley, thinks that manager Sean Dyche could become the England national team manager someday. Dyche, 43, has become well-known for improving the team's performance since he started at Burnley in October 22, 22. When he arrived, Burnley was expected to be relegated, but he led them to promotion to the Premier League last season. Duff, who used to play for Chesterfield, is getting ready to play against Tottenham in the Premier League on Sunday. He supports his manager, Sean Dyche, to one day manage the England team.

Mauricio Pochettino, Harry Kane’s manager, has allowed Kane to play in the European Under-21 Championships this summer. Roy Hodgson, England’s coach, has confirmed that Kane will be part of Gareth Southgate’s team for the tournament in the Czech Republic. This is happening even though Kane made his first appearance for the senior England team just last week. Kane will also travel to Australia and Malaysia before the championships start.

Harry Kane, who recently played for England against Italy, will compete in the Under-21 European Championships this year. He made his first start for England against Italy after coming on as a substitute and scoring a goal against Lithuania.

Alvaro Morata’s agent, Beppe Bozzo, says that Morata wants to stay at Juventus and does not want to return to Real Madrid. The 22-year player moved to Juventus last summer for £15.8 million. He had not been playing regularly for Real Madrid’s first team. At Juventus, Morata signed a five-year contract. During the 2013-14 season, he started only three games for Real Madrid in La Liga. Morata is happy at Juventus. The Spanish international has played well since moving to Turin. He has scored seven goals in 22 Serie A matches this season.

Hundreds of thousands of football fans have travel problems this weekend because of Easter rail repairs. There are more than 30 Premiership and Championship games scheduled for the long weekend, but large parts of the rail network are closed for repairs. More than half the games will have delays, so many fans are driving instead. The big match between Arsenal and Liverpool in London will also be affected. The Labour party says the Government failed to learn from the Boxing Day chaos, when nearly a million fans had terrible journeys to see their teams.

Mark Warburton, the manager of Brentford, was very happy that his team won 4-1 against Fulham. The game was a tough match in West London, played at Craven Cottage. Stuart Dallas scored two great goals. Alan Judge, who came on as a substitute in the second half, scored a perfect free-kick. Jota scored the fourth goal late in the game. This win gave Brentford 69 points and moved them to fifth place in the league. There are only six games left to play, and Brentford is still in a good position to reach the play-offs. Warburton said, "I am really pleased."

Sky Sports and BT Sport have announced the final TV schedule for the 2014-15 Barclays Premier League season. The games include the race for Champions League spots. The most important matches are Chelsea vs Liverpool on May 10 and Manchester United vs Arsenal on May 17. The TV schedule for the final day, Sunday, May 24, will be announced later. Juan Mata scored for Manchester United against Liverpool in a live TV match last month. Manchester United also beat Arsenal at the Emirates earlier this season. The date is Saturday, May 2, 12.

This American P-51D Mustang fighter jet is about 70 years old. It was rebuilt using more than 200 different parts. Bill and Scooter Yoak, a father and son, did the work. They did it carefully to honor American soldiers who died in war. The video shows the plane flying and doing tricks in the sky.

Grupo OAS, the company that owns Natal’s Dunas Arena, is selling the stadium because it has no enough money. The company also wants to sell half of its ownership in the Fonte Nova arena in Salvador. Grupo OAS has had money problems for months because of a corruption investigation at the state oil company Petrobras. This investigation made it hard for the builder to get loans.

A group of U.S. senators wrote to FIFA, the world governing body for football, asking them to strip Russia of the 2018 World Cup hosting rights. The senators blame Russia for its involvement in the Ukraine crisis and the occupation of Crimea. The letter, dated Tuesday and released on Wednesday, was signed by 13 Democratic and Republican lawmakers who strongly urged FIFA to move the tournament to another country.

Five people died when a helicopter crashed into a house in the Brazilian city of Sao Paulo. The crash happened in the Carapicuiba area, on the edge of the city, at about 5:20pm yesterday. One of the people who died was Thomaz Alckmin, the son of Sao Paulo’s governor, Geraldo Alckmin. The helicopter fell into a home in a residential neighborhood.

Jos Hooiveld scored a goal in the last minutes of the game to help Millwall beat their south London rivals, Charlton, 2-1. It was Millwall’s first win at Charlton’s stadium, The Den, since October.

Hooiveld scored in the 87th minute, after Magaye Gueye had equalled for Millwall. Gueye scored by pushing the ball into the net after a low shot. Alou Diarra had scored first for Charlton.

 Charlton’s captain, Chris Solly, was sent off in the first half for deliberately handling the ball in the penalty area. Stephen Henderson, Charlton’s goalkeeper, saved the resulting penalty kick taken by Lee Gregory. Substitute Magaye Gueye celebrated after scoring

The hatchback is the most popular car in the world. It turns 50 years old this year. It is not as fast as a Ferrari or as fancy as a Rolls Royce. But it is practical, cheap to run, and comfortable. Because of these things, it is popular all over the world, from Munich to Mexico City. In the UK, two in every three cars sold are hatchbacks. The first hatchback was the Renault 16, which came out in April 165. The Renault 4, which came before the Renault 16, was first made to help French farmers carry their sheep to market.

Juan Arango, the captain of the Mexican soccer team Tijuana, apologized to another player after biting him. The game was a very intense match between Tijuana and Monterrey. With only a few seconds left, Tijuana was losing 4-3. Arango walked up to Monterrey player Jesus Zavala and bit him on the shoulder.

Arango, who is 44 years old, said, "I did something I shouldn't have done with Zavala."

 The video shows Arango biting Zavala’s shoulder. Zavala held his shoulder after being bitten. Zavala’s team won the game 4-3. Zavala showed the referee the mark on his shoulder where he had been bitten.

Paul Merson started an argument with Andros Townsend again. Townsend played for Tottenham in a 0-0 tie against Burnley on Sunday. He came into the game with only seven minutes left. Merson wrote on Twitter: "Did you miss the coach? #RubberDub #7minutes." This was another comment by Merson about Townsend. Earlier, Merson had upset Townsend by writing in his Sky Sports column that if Townsend can play for England, then anyone can play for England.

Cristiano Ronaldo’s decline is not as bad as people thought. The Real Madrid player scored five goals against Granada. This brings his total to 36 goals in La Liga this season. This is more than half of the top teams in Europe. Real Madrid won 9-1 at the Bernabeu stadium. Ronaldo’s teammates helped him destroy Granada. This was the first time in his career that he scored five goals in one game. With 36 league goals, he has passed Lionel Messi, who has 32. Ronaldo has now scored more goals than 53 of the 98 teams in Europe’s top five leagues this season.

England is close to qualifying for Euro 2016, but manager Roy Hodgson seems unsure about his best starting lineup. Sportsmail reporters have picked their own starting teams for the tournament in France, assuming all players are healthy. You can share your choices for England’s starting eleven by leaving a comment below. The photo shows Roy Hodgson at Juventus Stadium during a friendly match against Italy on Tuesday. The suggested lineup is: Hart; Clyne, Cahill, Jagielka, Baines; Henderson, Wilshere; Welbeck, Rooney, Sterling; Kane.

Hull won a surprising 28-20 game against St Helens at Langtree Park. They had lost to Hull KR on Thursday, but this win was their revenge. This loss was St Helens' third in a row. Jamie Shaul scored a long-distance try that made sure of the win. The home team, St Helens, looked tired after their last game on Good Friday. The champions, St Helens, had many injured players. They also lost to Wigan last week. They started with two young, new players in their team. Hull saw this as a chance to win. Fetuli Talanoa, who played on the left, celebrated scoring against St Helens. Hull got a surprise victory.

Almeria, a team fighting to avoid being relegated from Spain's top league, has hired Sergi Barjuan as their third coach this season. Barjuan, 43, replaces Juan Ignacio Martinez, who was fired on Sunday. Martinez’s firing came one day after Almeria lost 4-1 to Levante at home. Almeria said that if all the paperwork is finished, Barjuan will coach the team’s away game against Barcelona on Wednesday. Barjuan used to play for Barcelona as a defender. He played 53 games for the Spanish national team between 1998 and 2004. He spent nine years at Barcelona and played in two World Cups for Spain. As Easter Sunday is approaching, Christians in America and around the world observed Good Friday, which is the day that remembers the death of Jesus Christ on the cross. People took part in "Way of the Cross" walks in places like Ohio, Pennsylvania, and across the Brooklyn Bridge. These were just some of the many events happening globally as Holy Week, which started on Palm Sunday, comes to a close.

Tens of thousands of people attended Pope Francis' Good Friday torchlight procession at the Colosseum in Rome, where the pope highlighted the persecution of Christians.

On Tuesday afternoon, England fans gathered at the Huntsman pub in central Turin. Some of them went outside to sing a song that uses the phrase “**** the IRA.” The song continues for a long time. Inside the Juventus Stadium, about 2,000 England fans sat in the northwest section (called the curva) and sang the same song. This happened during a friendly match that ended in a draw between England and Italy. The people shown in the picture were not involved in the singing.

Most ads in newsagent windows are practical, like selling kittens or offering handyman services. But one man, who called himself John, used an ad to find a partner. It worked better than internet dating for him. His ad went viral after someone took a photo and put it online. John, who is a builder, wrote his requirements in big black letters. He offered “a way of life with quality.” He put the ad in the window of a newsagent in Muswell Hill.

Helsingborg’s manager, Henrik Larsson, had to put 42-year-old Daniel Andersson in goal on Saturday. Andersson was the team’s kit man. Larsson had no choice because the regular goalkeepers, Par Hansson and Matt Pyzdrowski, were injured.

Amazingly, Andersson kept a clean sheet, meaning he didn’t let any goals in, and Helsingborg tied 0-0 with Kalmar in the first game of the Allsvenskan season.

After the game, Andersson spoke to local TV. He said, “It was a situation I never could have prepared for. I went from being the kit man, to being the goalie coach, to playing.”

Ben Jones-Bishop scored a great solo try to help the Salford Red Devils beat Wigan 24-18. This win ended a losing streak of 17 games against Wigan. The exciting match saw both teams finish with only 12 players because of fighting. Jones-Bishop, who joined Salford from Leeds Rhinos recently, now has seven tries this season, making him the team's top scorer. Salford was leading 12-8 at halftime. Jones-Bishop scored his try at the 60-minute mark, which helped Salford move up to third place in the league standings. Both teams ended the game with 12 players after tempers flared during the Super League match.

More than a year ago, Alan Pardew, who was managing Newcastle, had a bad argument with Manuel Pellegrini on the sidelines. The English football association (FA) warned Pardew about his behavior. Pardew then wrote to Pellegrini to apologize for the insult he used.

On Monday, at Selhurst Park, Pardew— now the manager of Crystal Palace— will face Pellegrini and Manchester City again. Pardew has taken steps to change his behavior because he worried it was becoming harmful.

After getting advice from the League Managers’ Association, the 53-year-old Pardew has worked with Jeremy Snape, a former international cricketer who is now a sports psychologist.

This weekend, Sportsmail will provide information for every Premier League game, including team news, expected lineups, betting odds, and statistics from Opta. Here is the information for Crystal Palace’s home game against Manchester City at Selhurst Park.

Crystal Palace manager Alan Pardew has no new injuries to report. However, Marouane Chamakh and Fraizer Campbell are still out with hamstring injuries, and Jordon Mutch has a thigh problem.

Some people think the title race is already decided, but Joe Hart remains very hopeful. He is paid to be positive, but his optimism has some logic. Manchester City won the league in 2012 and 2014 with dramatic late comebacks. Hart said, “That’s kind of how we do it.” When asked about overcoming a nine-point deficit, he added, “We like to do things differently. We haven’t played at the level we wanted to every week, but football gives you another chance, starting on Monday against Crystal Palace. We have eight big games left to reach the level we need.”

Mils Muliaina, a former rugby star who won the World Cup with the All Blacks, has been released on bail after being arrested for suspected sexual assault. The 34-year player denies the charges. He was taken into custody last night after his team, Connacht, lost 14-7 to Gloucester in the quarter finals of the European Challenge Cup. Muliaina had been injured during the match when police approached him. He was led away by officers at Kingsholm Stadium in connection with an incident in Cardiff in March.

QPR players feel confident about their upcoming match against Aston Villa on Tuesday. This is a important game in the Barclays Premier League. QPR had lost 13 of their 14 away games before they won 4-1 against West Brom on Saturday. This win ended a streak of five losses. QPR is still in 19th place, but they are only three points away from avoiding relegation. QPR coach Chris Ramsey told his players to stay calm during the 4-1 win against West Brom. Eduardo Vargas scored the first goal and celebrated with his teammates. Chris Ramsey said in a press conference on Monday that the win was fantastic and the team’s morale was high and professional.

Lydia Ko made a score of 74, which was two strokes over par, on Saturday at the ANA Inspiration golf tournament. This was her second round in a row where she scored higher than par. This happened right after she tied an LPGA Tour record for playing 29 straight rounds under par. The day before, Ko had hit her ball into the water and made a bogey on the 18th hole, which gave her a score of 73. On Saturday, she made an 8-foot birdie putt on the 5th hole (a par 5). This kept another long streak going. The 17-year-old from New Zealand has made at least one birdie in all 187 of her rounds in 49 career

Arsene Wenger hasn't decided yet if he will offer Abou Diaby a new contract. He hinted that the midfielder, who has had many injuries, might stay at Arsenal after the summer. Diaby recently returned to play in a practice game on Wednesday. However, he has only played 22 times in the last five years at Arsenal because he has been injured for long periods. Arsenal plays Liverpool on Saturday. Wenger probably won't put Diaby in this important game. But he suggested that Diaby could get a new contract, possibly one where he is paid based on how much he plays.

The absence of Tiger Woods and Rory McIlroy has never been an issue for the Shell Houston Open in Humble, a small suburb near Houston. Record crowds have come to watch the tournament, which is the final event before the Masters. The event has been a huge success, thanks to the entertaining play of popular golfer Phil Mickelson and local favorite Jordan Spieth.

18 months ago, Spieth, who was only 21 at the time, faced criticism for leaving college to join the PGA Tour. At that time, he was ranked 809th in the world. Since then, Spieth, now 21, has climbed to number four in the world rankings. Interestingly, no one is criticizing him anymore.
